blocked.busy: Available when the current task ends

page.heading: This Page
page.siteOn: Atd can act here only in tasks you start, and always asks before submitting.
page.siteOff: Atd asks before it does anything on this site.

compose.label: Ask Atd
compose.placeholder: Ask about this page, or tell Atd what to do
compose.placeholderNoPage: Tell Atd what to do in this browser
compose.otherPage: Atd can’t act on built-in pages like this one. Your request goes without it; Atd opens the sites it needs.

failure.notConnected: Lost the connection to Atd. Your request is kept; send it again once Atd reconnects.
failure.notPaired: Connect this browser to Atd first.
failure.tooLong: This request is too long for Atd. Shorten it, then send again.
failure.otherHost: Another Atd build is connected to this browser. Quit it, then send again.
failure.serviceUnavailable: Atd isn’t responding. Send again in a moment.
failure.failed: Atd couldn’t take this request. Send it again.

empty.title: What Should Atd Do?
empty.body: Ask about this page or describe a task. Atd works in tabs of this browser and asks before it submits anything.
empty.shortcut: Press {{shortcut}} on a page to ask right there.

runs.clipped: Shortened here. Open in Atd for the full reply.

connect.title: Connect to Atd
connect.body: Atd acts only in tabs you hand to a task, and asks before it submits anything.
connect.confirmNote: Confirm in the Atd app and check that it shows the same code.

failure.busy: Atd is showing another connection request.
failure.cooldown: Wait a moment before trying again.
failure.generic: Couldn’t connect to Atd. Try again.
failure.otherHost: Another Atd build is connected to this browser. Quit it, then try again.
failure.serviceUnavailable: Atd isn’t responding. Try again in a moment.
failure.denied: You didn’t allow the connection in Atd.
failure.notConnected: Lost the connection to Atd before you confirmed.

connecting.title: Connecting to Atd
connecting.body: Atd for Chrome is reaching the Atd app on this Mac.

disconnected.title: Lost Connection to Atd
disconnected.body: Atd for Chrome reconnects on its own while Atd is running.

otherHost.title: Another Atd Build Is Connected
otherHost.body: Another build of Atd is using this browser’s connection. Quit that build, then reconnect.

serviceUnavailable.title: Atd Isn’t Responding
serviceUnavailable.body: The Atd app is open, but its service isn’t answering yet. Reconnect, or quit and reopen Atd.

hostMissing.title: Open Atd to Finish Setup
hostMissing.body: This browser can’t reach Atd yet. Open Atd on this Mac—or click Refresh in Settings › Computer use—then try again.

browserNotVerified.title: This Browser Can’t Be Verified
browserNotVerified.body: Atd connects only to browsers signed with an Apple Developer ID. Switch to a signed browser build, then try again.

browserMismatch.title: Browser Signature Changed
browserMismatch.body: This connection is paired with a different signed browser. Disconnect it in Atd’s Settings › Computer use and pair again, or switch back to the original browser.
